_doc: #2153 — ONLY_CASTER bypasses zone membership. ONE fixture, TWO readers: the sim reader drives
cast::resolve_mob_cast with these same cells and effect rows.
Geometry uses the chain's 20-cell stride. The mob caster at 100 aims at enemy player 106; the
radius-1 circle [86,105,106,107,126] contains ally mob 105 and enemy 106, but NOT caster 100.
The ONLY_CASTER named-state row must reach caster 100 anyway. The TF_NOT_ENEMY damage row is the
positive control: it stays on the ordinary zone pass and damages ally 105 only.
